# qlib expression operators

45 operators usable in factor expressions. `$field` = a base field (see fields.md); `N` = an integer window. Compose freely, e.g. `Corr($close, Log($volume+1), 10)`.


## Element-wise

| operator | meaning |
|---|---|
| `Abs(feature)` | Feature Absolute Value |
| `If(condition, feature_left, feature_right)` | If Operator |
| `Log(feature)` | Feature Log |
| `Not(feature)` | Not Operator |
| `Sign(feature)` | Feature Sign |
| `TResample(feature, freq, func)` | Element-wise Operator |

## Pair (binary)

| operator | meaning |
|---|---|
| `Add(feature_left, feature_right)` | Add Operator |
| `And(feature_left, feature_right)` | And Operator |
| `Div(feature_left, feature_right)` | Division Operator |
| `Eq(feature_left, feature_right)` | Equal Operator |
| `Ge(feature_left, feature_right)` | Greater Equal Than Operator |
| `Greater(feature_left, feature_right)` | Greater Operator |
| `Gt(feature_left, feature_right)` | Greater Than Operator |
| `Le(feature_left, feature_right)` | Less Equal Than Operator |
| `Less(feature_left, feature_right)` | Less Operator |
| `Lt(feature_left, feature_right)` | Less Than Operator |
| `Mul(feature_left, feature_right)` | Multiply Operator |
| `Ne(feature_left, feature_right)` | Not Equal Operator |
| `Or(feature_left, feature_right)` | Or Operator |
| `Power(feature_left, feature_right)` | Power Operator |
| `Sub(feature_left, feature_right)` | Subtract Operator |
